name: karpathy-engineer
description: Operationalizes the Karpathy Method (spec via interview, explicit verification, environment rules) as Claude Code skills. Ships grill-me: a single, context-free interview skill for stress-testing plans and decisions. Ships karpathy-engineer: a 5-phase agile-bucket orchestrator that supplies goal-context to grill-me and chains into OpenSpec for technical work. Also vendors karpathy-coder wholesale: an active coding discipline enforcer (assumption/complexity/diff/goal checks) with a review agent, /karpathy-check command, and pre-commit hook.
